item.consent: Enrichment sends the text of every note, document and email in this store to openai (api.openai.com), model gpt-4o-mini: 3 records now, and every record added or changed later, at each sync. The model writes facts and questions about each record; they are kept in the store, and search finds the record by them. A question in other words finds its record more often in the top 5 and 10, but a question in the record's own words gets that record first a little less often (measured on synthetic data: 0.54 to 0.48). Enriching what is here now costs about $0.000153 (183 input and 210 output tokens). `memo models consents revoke` turns it off and deletes what the model wrote.
